editor.de: - "The trench itself had been found eight years earlier, by the British research ship HMS Challenger, under Captain Nares, far to the east."
editor.para: - "The trench itself had been found about a decade earlier, by the British research ship HMS Challenger, under Captain Nares, far to the east." (r2b, L69: "eight years" contava de 1875; o ano está em disputa, F22, C29)

editor.de: "Eight years earlier" (1875) sem abrir a frase com data (voz §1).
editor.para: "About a decade earlier" (r2b, L69), sem abrir a frase com data (voz §1) e sem o ano: as fontes do disco dão 26/03/1875, mas o IHR de 1936 põe o navio "cruising between St. Thomas, Virgin Islands and the Bermudas", o trecho de março de 1873; "about a decade" vale para os dois (F22, C29, N52).
